title: Gameplay Choices and Payment Controls
summary: Alfredo approved A’s grouped payment methods with C’s receipt, and B’s candidate tray with A’s source context and C’s quiet selection. Please review the native implementation of the remaining #499 controls before merging.
review_steps: Extract the whole ZIP and open Start Review.cmd. Choose a scenario in the top picker; Restart restores its real engine seed.

Payments: try Bow plus Reaction from Seaside Bazaar independently, destruction of a Holding and Moto Rani’s remove-for-discount method. The receipt separates Gold from cost reduction; no sources commit before confirmation.

Open Other previews/Review Choices.cmd. Try En’you hand-card or Sake-token entry choices, optional Event draw, Honor prevention/reaction, The Killing Grounds and Infiltrator Straighten. Only the deciding seat may see its candidates.
Choose candidates, clear the selection, inspect original source scans and confirm. Other seat uses the ordinary device-handoff flow; private choices must disappear and selection must reset.

Open Other previews/Review Optional Actions.cmd. Check the additional-action decline. Use the picker for Greasing the Wheels and the Kurohito Favor twin; Favor inspection should expose the engine-offered action.
Resize the window; check the integrated tray remains above the visible hand, horizontal scrolling and footer confirmation stay usable, and full scans remain readable through inspection.
Use Send Feedback.url for UI/QoL and mechanics corrections. Open Full Game.cmd opens the same build’s normal menus.
known_limitations: Unmerged draft PR. Alfredo approved the concepts, not mechanics or final graphical playability; Mendon/Nathan acceptance is required.

The twelve real-engine seeds contain training cards alongside published sources; they are isolated demonstrations, not additions to playable deck profiles. Event draw is seeded at the real pending-choice boundary.
Protocol 3 includes optional private candidate metadata and source conflicts. Client and server must run matching versions; no card rules or authoritative payment resolution moved into the UI.
Native macOS checks passed; Windows CI validates exported runtime and launchers, not Windows graphical playtesting.
The UI uses the existing responsive lacquer sidebar and a candidate tray above the ordinary hand. Concept images establish accepted grouping and interaction rather than replace the entire game shell.

Asahina Keigo’s variable discard-payment picker is not implemented. Its unresolved zero-amount source is disabled and cannot enable confirmation, even alongside sufficient other Gold. Core still accepts the authoritative named-discard command.
